title: O‘zingiz haqingizda ravon gapirish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida har qanday shaxsiy savolga javob, sabab, misol va qo‘shimcha fikrdan iborat o‘ttiz soniyalik ravon javob berasiz, to‘xtov iboralarini ishlatasiz va boy so‘zlar bilan o‘zingizni tasvirlaysiz.

scenes.title: O‘zingiz haqingizda ravon gapirish
scenes.say: Welcome back. In the last lesson we worked on tenses. Today we use them to talk about ourselves, fluently and in detail.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda zamonlarning nozik farqlarini o‘rgandik, past perfect va perfect continuous ni mashq qildik. Bugun bilimlaringizni ishga solamiz: o‘zingiz haqingizda ravon va batafsil gapirishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida har qanday shaxsiy savolga o‘ttiz soniyalik, mazmunli va tabiiy javob bera olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda zamonlar ustida ishladik. Bugun ulardan o‘zimiz haqimizda ravon va batafsil gapirish uchun foydalanamiz.

scenes.title: Nega kengaytirilgan javob kerak
scenes.say: Short answers close a conversation. Extended answers open it. In interviews and exams, you need to say more than yes or no.
scenes.say_native: Qisqa javob suhbatni yopadi, kengaytirilgan javob esa uni davom ettiradi. “Do you like your city?” savoliga “Yes” desangiz, tinglovchi yana savol berishga majbur. Imtihonda va intervyuda esa baholovchi sizning ravonligingiz va boyligingizni ko‘rishni xohlaydi. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchi ham ko‘pincha bir-ikki gap qo‘shib javob beradi. Maqsadimiz: har bir shaxsiy savolga taxminan o‘ttiz soniya gapirish.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa javoblar suhbatni to‘xtatadi, kengaytirilgan javoblar uni ochadi. Imtihon va intervyuda ha yoki yo‘qdan ko‘proq aytish kerak.

scenes.title: Texnika: javob, sabab, misol, qo‘shimcha
board: X – Extra: link back or contrast
scenes.say: Use four steps. Answer the question directly. Give a reason. Add an example. Finish with something extra, like a contrast or a link.
scenes.say_native: Oddiy to‘rt qadamli formula: birinchi, savolga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri javob bering. Ikkinchi, sabab keltiring. Uchinchi, misol qo‘shing. To‘rtinchi, oxirida yana bir narsa qo‘shing, masalan qarama-qarshilik yoki savolni qaytarish. Bu formula har qanday shaxsiy savolga mos keladi. Uni yodlab oling va avval sekin, keyin tezroq qo‘llang. Vaqt o‘tishi bilan formulani o‘ylamasdan ishlata boshlaysiz.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt qadam: savolga javob bering, sabab keltiring, misol qo‘shing va oxirida qo‘shimcha fikr yoki qarama-qarshilik bilan yakunlang.

scenes.title: Namuna: ishingiz haqida
board: R: I chose it because I like helping people.
E: For instance, last week I …

examples.t: I'm a nurse at a children's hospital.

scenes.say: I'm a nurse at a children's hospital. I chose it because I enjoy helping people. For instance, last week I looked after a boy who was afraid of injections, and by the end he was laughing. It's tiring, but it's really rewarding.
scenes.say_native: Namunani tahlil qilamiz. Birinchi gap: javob. Ikkinchi: “because” bilan sabab. Uchinchi: “for instance” bilan aniq voqea, va u o‘tgan zamonda hikoya qilinyapti, o‘tgan darsdagi zamonlar aynan shu yerda kerak. Oxirgi gap: “but” bilan qarama-qarshilik va xulosa. Jami to‘rt-besh gap, taxminan o‘ttiz soniya.
scenes.say_uz: Men bolalar kasalxonasida hamshiraman. Buni odamlarga yordam berishni yoqtirganim uchun tanladim. Masalan, o‘tgan hafta ukoldan qo‘rqqan bolaga qaradim va oxirida u kulayotgan edi. Charchatadi, lekin juda mamnuniyat beradi.

scenes.title: Namuna: yashash joyingiz
board: I’m originally from Samarkand, but I’ve been living in Tashkent for six years.
Samarkand is famous for its architecture, such as the Registan.
scenes.say: I'm originally from Samarkand, but I've been living in Tashkent for six years. Samarkand is famous for its history, for instance the Registan. I miss it, though I go back every summer.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir namuna. “Originally from” — asli qayerlik ekaningiz, “but I’ve been living in” — hozir qayerda yashashingiz. Bu yerda o‘tgan darsdagi present perfect continuous ishlatilgan. Keyin misol: “for instance the Registan”, va oxirida “though” bilan his-tuyg‘u qo‘shildi. Ko‘ryapsiz, shaxsiy savolga javob berish uchun hech qanday murakkab so‘z kerak emas, tuzilma muhim.
scenes.say_uz: Men asli samarqandlikman, lekin olti yildan beri Toshkentda yashayman. Samarqand tarixi bilan mashhur, masalan Registon. Uni sog‘inaman, garchi har yozda boraman.

scenes.title: Juda qisqa javob
board: ✗ Q: Do you like cooking? A: Yes.
✓ Yes, I do. I find it relaxing, and I often try new recipes at weekends.
scenes.say: A one-word answer is not enough. Say: Yes, I do. I find it relaxing, and I often try new recipes at weekends.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato: bir so‘zli javob. “Yes” yoki “No” dan keyin to‘xtab qolish. Bu qo‘pol emas, lekin imtihonda ball bermaydi, suhbatda esa qiyin pauza yaratadi. Har doim to‘liq gap bilan javob bering, keyin sabab yoki tafsilot qo‘shing. Bu odat tez shakllanadi: bir hafta davomida har bir savolga kamida ikki gap bilan javob berishga urining.
scenes.say_uz: Bir so‘zli javob yetarli emas. To‘liq javob bering, so‘ng sabab yoki tafsilot qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Juda uzun yoki mavzudan chiqish
board: ✗ 3 minutes about one detail, then a new topic
✓ 30–40 seconds, then stop or ask back
scenes.say: The opposite mistake is also real. Do not talk for three minutes. Give about thirty seconds, then stop or ask a question back.
scenes.say_native: Teskari xato ham bor: savolga javob berishni unutib, uzoq vaqt gapirib ketish. Masalan, kasbingiz haqida so‘ralsa, bolalik xotiralaringizga o‘tib ketish. Bu ham suhbatni buzadi. Qoida oddiy: o‘ttiz-qirq soniya gapiring, keyin to‘xtang yoki savolni qaytaring: “And what about you?” Shunda suhbat tabiiy, ikki tomonlama bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Teskari xato: uch daqiqa gapirib ketish. O‘ttiz soniya gapiring, so‘ng to‘xtang yoki savol qaytaring.

scenes.title: Javobni kengaytiring
board: Q: Do you like your city?
scenes.say: Extend this answer. Do you like your city? Give an answer, a reason, and an example.
scenes.say_native: Savol: shahringiz sizga yoqadimi? Javob, sabab va misolni ayting. Masalan, “Yes, I do, because…”. Keyin “for instance” bilan aniq misol keltiring. Yigirma soniya vaqtingiz bor, baland ovozda gapiring. Shoshilmang: avval javobni bir gapda ayting, keyin sababni, so‘ng misolni qo‘shing. Har bir qadam bir gap bo‘lsin.
scenes.say_uz: Shahringiz sizga yoqadimi? Javob, sabab va misol bering.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Yes, I do, mainly because it’s lively.
For instance, there’s always something to do at weekends.
The only downside is the traffic.

examples.t: Yes, I do, mainly because it's lively.

scenes.say: Yes, I do, mainly because it's so lively. For instance, there's always something to do at weekends. The only downside is the traffic.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javob: “Yes, I do, mainly because it’s so lively. For instance, there’s always something to do at weekends. The only downside is the traffic.” Sizniki albatta boshqa bo‘lishi mumkin, masalan tinchlik yoki odamlar haqida. Tekshiring: javob, sabab, misol va qo‘shimcha fikr bormi? Bo‘lsa, siz to‘g‘ri yo‘ldasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Ha, asosan jonli bo‘lgani uchun. Masalan, dam olish kunlari doim qiladigan ish topiladi. Yagona kamchilik, tirbandlik.

scenes.title: Sabab bildirish
board: as / since + clause (a bit more formal)

examples.t: I enjoy it because it's challenging.
We stayed home because of the weather.
It's cheap, so I go there often.
examples.uz: U arzon, shuning uchun tez-tez boraman.

scenes.say: I enjoy it because it's challenging. We stayed in because of the weather. It's cheap, so I go there often.
scenes.say_native: Sabab bildirishning bir nechta yo‘li bor. “Because” dan keyin to‘liq gap, ya’ni ega va kesim keladi. “Because of” dan keyin faqat ot yoki ot birikmasi keladi. “As” va “since” ko‘proq yozma yoki rasmiy nutqda uchraydi. Natijani bildirishda esa “so” va “that’s why” ishlatiladi. Bu xilma-xillik boylikni oshiradi: har gapda faqat “because” deyavermang.
scenes.say_uz: Because dan keyin gap, because of dan keyin ot keladi. Natijani so va that’s why bildiradi.

scenes.title: Misol keltirish

examples.t: I like team sports, such as volleyball.
examples.uz: Menga jamoaviy sport yoqadi, masalan voleybol.

examples.t: Take my brother, for example. He started at 18.

scenes.say: I like team sports, such as volleyball. Take my brother, for example. A good example is my first job.
scenes.say_native: Misol keltirish nutqni ishonarli qiladi. “For example” va “for instance” gap boshida keladi. “Such as” esa ot oldidan, gap ichida: “team sports, such as volleyball”. Yana jonli yo‘l: “Take my brother, for example”, ya’ni “akamni oling”. Yoki “A good example is…”. Bu iboralar B1 darajasidagi “like” o‘rniga ishlatiladi: “I like sports like football” emas, “such as football”.
scenes.say_uz: Misol uchun for example, for instance ishlatiladi. Such as ot oldidan gap ichida keladi. Take my brother, for example, jonli ibora.

scenes.title: Because yolg‘iz yoki because of
board: ✗ I like it. Because I like.
scenes.say: Because is followed by a full clause. Because of is followed by a noun. Because it is cheap. Because of the price.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita xato. Birinchisi: “because” bilan alohida gap boshlab, uni to‘liq qilmaslik: “I like it. Because I like.” Ikkinchisi: “because of” dan keyin to‘liq gap qo‘yish: “because of it is cheap”. To‘g‘risi: “because it is cheap” yoki “because of the price”. O‘zbekchada “chunki” va “tufayli” alohida so‘zlar, shuning uchun bu farq sizga yot emas. Faqat ularni inglizcha shaklga moslang.
scenes.say_uz: Because dan keyin to‘liq gap, because of dan keyin ot. Because it is cheap. Because of the price.

scenes.title: Sabab va misol qo‘shing
scenes.say: Finish each sentence. Use the word in brackets. Say the full sentence.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni tugating. Birinchisini “because” bilan, ikkinchisini “such as” bilan, uchinchisini “because of” bilan. O‘zingizga tegishli haqiqiy ma’lumotni ayting, shunda mashq foydali bo‘ladi. Birinchi gapda sababdan keyin to‘liq gap keladi, uchinchisida esa faqat ot. Gaplarni baland ovozda ayting va farqni his qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni qavs ichidagi so‘z bilan tugating. To‘liq gapni ayting.

scenes.title: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar
board: 1) I like my job because it’s varied.
2) I enjoy sport, such as swimming and tennis.
3) I didn’t go out because of the rain.
scenes.say: I like my job because it's varied. I enjoy sport, such as swimming and tennis. I didn't go out because of the rain.
scenes.say_native: Mana variantlar: “I like my job because it’s varied.” “I enjoy sport, such as swimming and tennis.” “I didn’t go out because of the rain.” Sizning javoblaringiz shaxsiy bo‘lgani uchun boshqacha bo‘ladi. Muhimi, “because” dan keyin gap, “because of” dan keyin ot. Shuningdek, “such as” dan keyin ro‘yxat keldi.
scenes.say_uz: Ishim xilma-xil bo‘lgani uchun yoqadi. Sport, masalan suzish va tennis menga yoqadi. Yomg‘ir tufayli tashqariga chiqmadim.

scenes.title: Tinglash: tanishuv suhbati
board: Jack: So, what do you do, Dilya?
Dilya: I’m a software tester. I got into it by accident, actually.
scenes.say: Jack: So, what do you do, Dilya? Dilya: I'm a software tester. I got into it by accident, actually. I was studying maths, and a friend suggested I try it. Jack: How come you stayed? Dilya: Well, I love finding problems before users do. It's like solving puzzles all day.
scenes.say_native: Endi tabiiy suhbatni tinglang. Jek Dilyadan nima ish qilishini so‘raydi. Dilya qisqa javob bermaydi: ishi, uni qanday topgani va nega qolgani haqida gapiradi. Savollar: Dilya qanday qilib bu kasbga kirgan va nega qolgan? Birinchi eshitishda faqat umumiy ma’noga e’tibor bering. Dilyaning javobi qanday qatlamlardan tuzilganini payqashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Jek: Xo‘sh, Dilya, nima ish qilasiz? Dilya: Dasturiy ta’minot sinovchisiman. Aslida bu ishga tasodifan kirib qolganman. Matematikada o‘qirdim va do‘stim sinab ko‘rishni maslahat berdi. Jek: Nega qolding? Dilya: Foydalanuvchilardan oldin muammolarni topishni yaxshi ko‘raman. Kun bo‘yi jumboq yechgandek.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 1) How did Dilya get into her job?
scenes.say: How did Dilya get into her job? Why did she stay?
scenes.say_native: Ikki savolga javob bering. Dilya bu kasbga qanday kirgan? Nega u shu ishda qolgan? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling va zamonlarni to‘g‘ri tanlang. Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Dilya o‘tgan voqeani qaysi zamonda aytganini ham eslang.
scenes.say_uz: Dilya bu ishga qanday kirgan? U nega qolgan?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1) By accident: a friend suggested it.
2) She loves finding problems before users do.
scenes.say: She got into it by accident, because a friend suggested it. She stayed because she loves finding problems before users do.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: u tasodifan kirgan, chunki do‘sti maslahat bergan. U qolgan, chunki foydalanuvchilardan oldin muammolarni topishni yaxshi ko‘radi. Kuzating, Dilya bir savolga uch qatlamli javob berdi: javob, sabab va o‘xshatish. Aynan shunday javoblar suhbatni tabiiy va qiziqarli qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: U tasodifan kirgan, chunki do‘sti maslahat bergan. U muammolarni foydalanuvchilardan oldin topishni yaxshi ko‘rgani uchun qolgan.

scenes.title: To‘ldiruvchi so‘zlar
scenes.say: Fillers like well, you know, I mean and actually are normal in speech. They give you time and make you sound natural.
scenes.say_native: To‘ldiruvchi so‘zlar nutqning tabiiy qismi. “Well” — gapni boshlash, “you know” — tinglovchini sherik qilish, “I mean” — o‘zingizni aniqlashtirish, “actually” — qo‘shimcha yoki tuzatish, “to be honest” — ochiq aytish, “sort of” va “kind of” — gapni yumshatish. Ular sizga o‘ylash uchun vaqt beradi va ravon eshitiladi. Lekin ularni me’yorida ishlating, har gapda bittadan ko‘p bo‘lmasin.
scenes.say_uz: Well, you know, I mean, actually kabi so‘zlar nutqni tabiiy qiladi va o‘ylash uchun vaqt beradi.

scenes.title: Ona tilidagi to‘xtov tovushlari
board: ✓ Well… let me think… I mean…
scenes.say: Do not switch to your own language fillers or freeze in silence. Use English ones: well, let me think, I mean.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik o‘quvchi to‘xtaganda ona tilidagi “mana”, “ya’ni”, “eee” kabi so‘zlarni aytadi. Bu inglizcha nutqni buzadi va ravonlikka salbiy ta’sir qiladi. Yoki butunlay jim qoladi. Buning o‘rniga bir nechta tayyor inglizcha iborani yodlab oling: “well”, “let me think”, “I mean”. Ular xuddi yo‘l belgisi kabi: o‘ylab ulgurasiz, tinglovchi esa chalg‘imaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Ona tilidagi to‘xtov so‘zlari va uzoq jimlikdan qoching. Inglizchasini ishlating: well, let me think, I mean.

scenes.title: Vaqt yutish iboralari
board: Let me think for a second.

examples.t: That's a good question. Let me think.

scenes.say: That's a good question. Let me think for a second. How can I put it? What I'd say is that I'm a morning person.
scenes.say_native: Qiyin savol kelganda tayyor iboralar yordam beradi: “That’s a good question”, “Let me think for a second”, “How can I put it?”, “What I’d say is…”. Bular ravon va ishonchli eshitiladi, chunki ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham shunday qiladi. Eng muhimi, to‘xtovdan keyin davom eting. To‘xtov — nutqning bir qismi, lekin uzoq cho‘zilmasin: ikki-uch soniyadan oshmasin.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi savol. Bir soniya o‘ylab olay. Qanday desam ekan? Men ertalab turishni yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: To‘xtov bilan javob bering
board: Q: What are you most proud of?
Start with: That’s a good question …
scenes.say: Answer this question. Start with a time-buying phrase. What are you most proud of?
scenes.say_native: Savol: nima bilan eng ko‘p faxrlanasiz? Javobni vaqt yutish iborasi bilan boshlang: “That’s a good question”, keyin “let me think” yoki “I mean”. Sabab va misol qo‘shing. Yigirma soniya gapiring. Esda tuting, to‘xtov iborasidan keyin to‘xtab qolmang, davom eting. Fikringizni sabab bilan asoslashni unutmang.
scenes.say_uz: Nima bilan eng ko‘p faxrlanasiz? Javobni vaqt yutish iborasi bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: That’s a good question. I suppose I’m proud of learning English on my own.
I mean, I started from zero, and now I can follow a podcast.
Actually, that’s why I keep going.
scenes.say: That's a good question. I suppose I'm proud of learning English on my own. I mean, I started from zero, and now I can follow a podcast. That's what keeps me going.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “That’s a good question. I suppose I’m proud of learning English on my own. I mean, I started from zero, and now I can follow a podcast. That’s what keeps me going.” Ko‘ryapsiz, ikkita to‘xtov iborasi, bir sabab va aniq natija. Sizning javobingiz boshqa mavzuda bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin tuzilma shu. “I suppose” ham foydali: u fikrni yumshoq bildiradi.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi savol. Menimcha, ingliz tilini o‘zim o‘rganganim bilan faxrlanaman. Noldan boshlagan edim, endi podkastni tushunaman.

scenes.title: Lug‘at boyligi: o‘zingizni tasvirlash
board: I tend to … / I’m the type of person who …

examples.t: I tend to be a bit of a perfectionist.
I'm the type of person who plans everything.

scenes.say: I tend to be a bit of a perfectionist. I'm the type of person who plans everything. My friends say I'm very reliable.
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tasvirlashda “I am nice” dan chiqing. Sifatlar: “outgoing” — ochiq, “reserved” — ketma-ket, “easy-going” — yengil tabiatli, “reliable” — ishonchli, “ambitious” — o‘ziga maqsad qo‘yadigan. Iboralar: “I tend to be…” — men odatda… bo‘laman, “I’m the type of person who…”. Do‘stlaringiz nima deyishini ham qo‘shsangiz, nutq tabiiy chiqadi.
scenes.say_uz: Men biroz mukammallikka intilaman. Men hamma narsani rejalashtiradigan odamman. Do‘stlarim juda ishonchli deyishadi.

scenes.title: Ish va o‘qish: tayyor birikmalar
board: I work as … / I’m in charge of …
I’m currently studying … / I’m planning to …

examples.t: I'm in charge of a small team.
What I enjoy most is the variety.

scenes.say: I work as an accountant. I'm in charge of a small team. What I enjoy most is the variety.
scenes.say_native: Ish haqida gapirganda tayyor birikmalar juda foydali. “I work as…” — kim bo‘lib ishlayman. “I’m in charge of…” — mas’ulman. “It involves…” — bu ish nimalarni o‘z ichiga oladi. “What I enjoy most is…” — menga eng yoqadigani. O‘qish haqida: “I’m currently studying…” va “I’m planning to…”. Bu birikmalarni mashq qilsangiz, ish va o‘qish haqidagi savollarga o‘ylamasdan javob berasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Men buxgalter bo‘lib ishlayman. Kichik jamoaga mas’ulman. Menga eng yoqadigani, xilma-xillik.

scenes.title: Shaxsiy ma’lumotlarda uchraydigan xatolar
scenes.say: I'm twenty-five. I was born in Bukhara. I agree. Do not say I have twenty-five years, I born, or I am agree.
scenes.say_native: Mana uchta xato, ularni o‘zbek va rus tili ta’sirida juda ko‘p kuzatamiz. Birinchisi: yoshni “have” bilan aytish. Inglizchada “I am twenty-five”. Ikkinchisi: “I born” deyish, chunki o‘zbekchada “tug‘ilganman” bitta so‘z. Inglizchada majhul nisbat kerak: “I was born”. Uchinchisi: “I am agree”. “Agree” o‘zi fe’l, “am” kerak emas. Bu xatolarni bir marta tuzatib oling.
scenes.say_uz: Yoshni have bilan aytmaymiz, I’m 25 deymiz. I was born. I agree.

scenes.title: Gaplarni tuzating va yaxshilang
board: 1) I born in 1998 and I am agree to live here.
2) I am a very nice person and I have 30 years.
3) I work teacher since five years.
scenes.say: Correct each sentence and make it sound more B2.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni to‘g‘rilang va ularni B2 darajasiga ko‘taring. Zamonni ham, kasb bildiruvchi iborani ham, ishlatilgan so‘zlarni ham tekshiring. Masalan, “nice” o‘rniga aniqroq sifat tanlang. Har bir gapda bittadan ortiq xato bo‘lishi mumkin. Avval xatolarni toping, so‘ng aniqroq so‘zlar bilan gapni boyiting.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni to‘g‘rilang va B2 darajasiga ko‘taring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I was born in 1998, and I’m happy to live here.
2) I’m outgoing and reliable, and I’m 30.
3) I’ve been working as a teacher for five years.
scenes.say: I was born in 1998, and I'm happy to live here. I'm outgoing and reliable, and I'm thirty. I've been working as a teacher for five years.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchida “I was born” va “agree” o‘rniga boshqa so‘z kerak edi, masalan “happy to live”. Ikkinchida yosh “I’m thirty” va “nice” o‘rniga “outgoing and reliable”. Uchinchida “since five years” noto‘g‘ri. Kasb bilan “as”, davomiylik bilan “for”, shuning uchun “I’ve been working as a teacher for five years”. Birinchi darsdagi xatolar bilan bog‘liqligini sezdingizmi?
scenes.say_uz: Men 1998 yilda tug‘ilganman va bu yerda yashashdan xursandman. Men ochiq va ishonchli odamman, o‘ttiz yoshdaman. Besh yildan beri o‘qituvchi bo‘lib ishlayman.

scenes.title: Ro‘yxat va ohang
board: Rising ↗ on items in a list, falling ↘ on the last
I like tennis ↗, swimming ↗, and cycling ↘

examples.t: I like tennis, swimming and cycling.
examples.uz: Menga tennis, suzish va velosiped yoqadi.

scenes.say: In a list, the voice rises on each item and falls on the last one. I like tennis, swimming, and cycling.
scenes.say_native: Nutq ravon eshitilishi uchun ohang ham muhim. Ro‘yxat aytganda har bir elementda ovoz biroz ko‘tariladi, bu “hali davom etaman” degani. Oxirgi elementda esa ovoz tushadi, bu “tugadi” degani. “I like tennis, swimming, and cycling.” Yana nutqni ma’no bo‘laklariga bo‘lib, vergul joyida qisqa pauza qiling. Shunda tinglovchi sizni oson kuzatadi. O‘zbekcha nutqda ham xuddi shunday, shuning uchun sizga tanish bo‘ladi.
scenes.say_uz: Ro‘yxatda har bir elementda ovoz ko‘tariladi, oxirgisida tushadi. Nutqni ma’no bo‘laklariga ajrating.

scenes.title: Ohang bilan takrorlang
board: I like tennis, swimming, and cycling.
My hobbies are reading, cooking, and travelling.
scenes.say: Repeat after me. Voice up on the first items, and down on the last.
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Birinchi elementlarda ovozni ko‘taring, oxirgisida tushiring. Avval “I like tennis, swimming, and cycling.” Keyin ikkinchi gapni ayting. Faqat so‘zlarni emas, ohangni ham takrorlashga harakat qiling. Ohangni bo‘rttirib ayting, shunda yaxshi o‘rganasiz. Keyin tabiiy ohangga qaytib, bir nafasda takrorlang.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang. Dastlabki elementlarda ovoz ko‘tarilsin, oxirgisida tushsin.

scenes.title: Ohang izohi
scenes.say: Good. The rise says there is more, and the fall says I have finished.
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. Ko‘tarilish “yana bor” degan signal beradi, tushish esa “tugatdim” degan signal. Agar oxirgi so‘zda ham ovoz ko‘tarilib qolsa, tinglovchi sizdan yana davom etishingizni kutadi va noqulay pauza paydo bo‘ladi. Shuning uchun gap oxirida ovozni tushirib, ishonch bilan tugating.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘tarilish yana bor degani, tushish tugadi degani.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ziyofatda
board: Sam: What do you do in your free time?
Aziza: I’m really into photography. I take my camera everywhere.
scenes.say: Sam: What do you do in your free time? Aziza: I'm really into photography. I take my camera everywhere, even to work. Last month I took photos at a friend's wedding, which was a lot of fun. Sam: Do you take portraits? Aziza: Mostly landscapes, to be honest, but I'd like to try portraits.
scenes.say_native: Oxirgi dialogni tinglang. Sem bo‘sh vaqt haqida so‘raydi. Aziza qiziqishi, kamera bilan odati va yaqinda bo‘lgan voqea haqida gapiradi. “To be honest” iborasini ham eshiting. Savollar: Aziza nima bilan shug‘ullanadi va oxirgi oy nima qilgan? Birinchi eshitishda umumiy mazmunni oling. Aziza qaysi zamonlarni ishlatayotganini ham payqashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say_uz: Sem: Bo‘sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz? Aziza: Men fotosuratga qiziqaman. Kamerani hamma joyga, hatto ishga ham olib boraman. O‘tgan oy do‘stimning to‘yida suratga oldim, bu juda yoqimli bo‘ldi. Sem: Portret ham olasizmi? Aziza: Ochig‘i, asosan manzara, lekin portretni sinab ko‘rmoqchiman.

scenes.title: Tushunish savollari
board: 2) What did she do last month?
3) What would she like to try?
scenes.say: What is Aziza into? What did she do last month? What would she like to try?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Aziza nimaga qiziqadi? O‘tgan oy nima qildi? Nimani sinab ko‘rmoqchi? Har bir javobda to‘g‘ri zamonni ishlating va to‘liq gap ayting. Javoblaringizni to‘liq gap bilan ayting va zamonlarga e’tibor bering: odat, o‘tgan voqea va xohish bir xil zamonda emas.
scenes.say_uz: Aziza nimaga qiziqadi? O‘tgan oy nima qildi? Nimani sinab ko‘rmoqchi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 2) She took photos at a friend’s wedding.
scenes.say: She is into photography. Last month she took photos at a friend's wedding. She would like to try portraits.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Aziza fotosuratga qiziqadi, “is into photography”. O‘tgan oy do‘stining to‘yida suratga olgan, “took photos”, past simple. Portretni sinab ko‘rmoqchi, “would like to try”. Diqqat qiling: u odatni present simple da, aniq voqeani past simple da, rejani esa “would like” bilan aytdi. Siz ham o‘z javoblaringizda shunday qatlamlar yarating.
scenes.say_uz: U fotosuratga qiziqadi. O‘tgan oy do‘stining to‘yida suratga olgan. Portretni sinab ko‘rmoqchi.

scenes.title: Vaqt me’yori
scenes.say: Thirty seconds is about four to six sentences. That is enough for an answer, a reason, an example and an extra thought.
scenes.say_native: Vaqtni his qilish uchun bir mezon: o‘ttiz soniya taxminan to‘rt-olti gap, ya’ni oltmish-sakson so‘z. Bu javob, sabab, misol va qo‘shimcha fikr uchun yetarli. Yozuvingizni telefonda tekshiring. Agar o‘n soniyada tugasa, yetarlicha kengaytirmagansiz. Agar bir daqiqadan oshsa, ortiqcha tafsilotni kesing. Mashq bilan o‘z me’yoringizni topasiz.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ttiz soniya taxminan to‘rt-olti gap. Bu javob, sabab, misol va qo‘shimcha fikr uchun yetadi.

scenes.title: Savol 1: Bo‘sh vaqt
board: What do you do in your free time?
scenes.say: Now answer this question: What do you do in your free time? Speak for twenty seconds.
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz sinab ko‘ring. Savol: bo‘sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz? Javob, sabab, misol va qo‘shimcha fikrni ishlating. Kamida bitta to‘xtov iborasi va bitta “such as” yoki “for instance” bo‘lsin. Yigirma soniya gapiring. Telefoningizda yozib oling va keyin tinglang. Javob, sabab, misol va qo‘shimcha fikr, ya’ni to‘rt qadamni tekshiring.
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz? Yigirma soniya gapiring.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I find it relaxing, and it keeps me fit.
For instance, I ran my first 10K last spring.
scenes.say: Well, I'm really into running. I find it relaxing, and it keeps me fit. For instance, I ran my first ten kilometres last spring. I'd like to try a half marathon next.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “Well, I’m really into running. I find it relaxing, and it keeps me fit. For instance, I ran my first ten kilometres last spring. I’d like to try a half marathon next.” Ko‘ryapsizmi, bu yerda to‘xtov so‘zi, sabab, misol va kelajak reja bor. Sizniki o‘zingizning qiziqishingiz haqida bo‘ladi, lekin tuzilma bir xil.
scenes.say_uz: Men yugurishga qiziqaman. U menga tinchlik beradi va sog‘lom saqlaydi. O‘tgan bahorda birinchi o‘n kilometrimni yugurdim.

scenes.title: Savol 2: Kelajak rejalari
board: Where do you see yourself in five years?
Use: I’d like to …, I hope to …, ideally …
scenes.say: Next question: Where do you see yourself in five years? Speak for twenty seconds.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi savol: besh yildan keyin o‘zingizni qayerda ko‘rasiz? “I’d like to”, “I hope to” yoki “ideally” iboralaridan foydalaning. Sabab va misol qo‘shing. Oxirida qo‘shimcha fikr bilan yakunlang. Yigirma soniya vaqtingiz bor. Rejalar haqida gapirganda sabab ayting: nega aynan shu maqsad? Bu javobingizni ancha mazmunli qiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Besh yildan keyin o‘zingizni qayerda ko‘rasiz? Yigirma soniya gapiring.

scenes.title: Namuna va o‘z-o‘zini tekshirish
board: Ideally, I’ll be managing my own team.
I hope to have moved abroad for a while.
Check: reason? example? linkers? new words?
scenes.say: Ideally, I'll be managing my own team, because I enjoy leading projects. I also hope to have lived abroad for a while.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “Ideally, I’ll be managing my own team, because I enjoy leading projects. I also hope to have lived abroad for a while.” Endi o‘zingizni tekshiring: sabab bormi? Misol? Bog‘lovchilar? Kamida bitta yangi so‘z? Birinchi darsda o‘rgangan mezonlarni qo‘llang: ravonlik, aniqlik, boylik. Ko‘p ishlasangiz, bu tekshiruv o‘z-o‘zidan ketadi.
scenes.say_uz: Ideal holda o‘z jamoamni boshqaraman, chunki loyihalarni boshqarishni yoqtiraman. Yana bir muddat chet elda yashagan bo‘lishga umid qilaman.

scenes.title: Qisqa shaxsiy hikoya qo‘shing
board: Past simple for events, past continuous for scene

examples.t: Last year I was working in a cafe when I decided to study IT.
examples.uz: O‘tgan yili kafeda ishlayotganimda IT o‘qishga qaror qildim.

scenes.say: A tiny story makes an answer memorable. Last year I was working in a cafe when I decided to study IT.
scenes.say_native: Misol sifatida kichik shaxsiy hikoya qo‘shish javobni esda qolarli qiladi. Bir-ikki gap yetarli: “Last year I was working in a cafe when I decided to study IT”. Bu yerda o‘tgan darsdagi mantiq ishlayapti: fon past continuous da, qaror past simple da. Bitta aniq tafsilot, masalan joy, ism yoki raqam, tinglovchiga javobingizni jonli ko‘rsatadi va umumiy gaplardan farq qildiradi.
scenes.say_uz: Kichik hikoya javobni esda qolarli qiladi. O‘tgan yili kafeda ishlayotganimda IT o‘qishga qaror qildim.

scenes.title: Qayerliksiz va qayerda yashaysiz: tayyor iboralar
board: I’m originally from … but I’m based in …

examples.t: I grew up in a small town near Fergana.
examples.uz: Men Farg‘ona yaqinidagi kichik shaharchada o‘sganman.

scenes.say: I grew up in a small town near Fergana. I'm based in Tashkent now. I've lived here since 2019.
scenes.say_native: Yashash joyi haqidagi savollar uchun tayyor iboralar: “I grew up in…” — o‘sgan joyingiz, “I’m based in…” — hozir turadigan joyingiz, “I’ve lived here for…” yoki “since…”. Diqqat qiling: “since” dan keyin vaqt nuqtasi, “for” dan keyin davomiylik keladi. Shahar haqida “lively”, “peaceful”, “crowded” kabi aniq sifatlar ishlating, “nice” o‘rniga.
scenes.say_uz: Men Farg‘ona yaqinidagi kichik shaharchada o‘sganman. Hozir Toshkentda yashayman. 2019 yildan beri shu yerdaman.

scenes.title: Savolni qaytarish

examples.t: I enjoy hiking. How about you?

scenes.say: I enjoy hiking. How about you? Real conversation goes both ways.
scenes.say_native: Suhbat ikki tomonlama bo‘lishi kerak. O‘ttiz soniya gapirgach, savolni qaytaring: “And what about you?”, “How about you?” yoki aniqroq: “Have you ever been hiking?”. Bu ham ravonlik belgisi, chunki siz suhbatni boshqarasiz. Imtihonda esa buni haddan ziyod ishlatmang, javobingiz to‘liq bo‘lgandan keyingina qaytaring.
scenes.say_uz: Men tog‘ sayohatini yoqtiraman. Sizchi? Haqiqiy suhbat ikki tomonlama bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Xulosa
board: because / because of / such as / for instance
Fillers: well, I mean, let me think
scenes.say: Let us recap. Use answer, reason, example and extra. Use fillers to buy time. Upgrade your vocabulary, and finish lists with a falling voice.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Kengaytirilgan javob formulasi: javob, sabab, misol, qo‘shimcha fikr. Sabab uchun because va because of ni farqlang, misol uchun such as va for instance dan foydalaning. Well, I mean, let me think kabi iboralar sizga o‘ylash vaqti beradi. Lug‘atni boyiting va ro‘yxatda ovozni oxirida tushiring. Bu usullar sizni o‘ttiz soniya ravon gapirishga olib keladi.
scenes.say_uz: Javob, sabab, misol va qo‘shimcha fikrdan foydalaning. To‘xtov iboralari, boy lug‘at va ro‘yxatdagi ohang nutqni ravon qiladi.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Choose: job, hometown, free time, goals, a recent experience
scenes.say: Homework: answer five personal questions, thirty seconds each. Record yourself and check each answer.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: beshta shaxsiy savolga o‘ttiz soniyadan javob bering: ish yoki o‘qish, tug‘ilgan joyingiz, bo‘sh vaqt, maqsadlaringiz va yaqindagi voqea haqida. Har birini yozib oling va tinglang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir javobda sabab, misol va kamida bitta to‘xtov iborasi bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda shart gaplarni, ya’ni real, gipotetik va aralash turlarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: beshta shaxsiy savolga o‘ttiz soniyadan javob bering, yozib oling va tekshiring.

homework_uz: Beshta shaxsiy savolga (ish yoki o‘qish, tug‘ilgan joy, bo‘sh vaqt, maqsadlar, yaqindagi voqea) o‘ttiz soniyadan javob bering va yozib oling. Har bir javobda sabab, misol va kamida bitta to‘xtov iborasi bo‘lsin.

quiz.q: Which answer is the best extended answer to 'Do you like cooking?'
options: Yes, I do. I find it relaxing, for instance when I try new recipes at weekends.
quiz.why_uz: Yaxshi javobda sabab va misol bor.

options: I like the city because of it is lively.
I like the city because it is lively.
I like the city because lively.
I like the city because of lively it.
quiz.why_uz: Because dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi.

options: We stayed in because of the rain.
We stayed in because of it rained.
We stayed in because the rain.
quiz.why_uz: Because of dan keyin ot keladi.
Such as ot oldidan misol keltiradi.
Yosh be fe'li bilan aytiladi: I'm 25.

options: I'm working as a teacher for five years.
I've been working as a teacher for five years.
I work as a teacher from five years.
I work as a teacher since five years.
quiz.why_uz: Davomiylik uchun present perfect continuous va for.

quiz.q: Which is a good time-buying phrase?
options: That's a good question. Let me think.

quiz.q: In the list 'tennis, swimming and cycling', the voice usually:
options: rises on every item including the last
rises on the first items and falls on the last

quiz.q: About how long is a 30-second answer?
quiz.why_uz: O‘ttiz soniya taxminan to‘rt-olti gapga teng.
